definitions.slaveOnly: The ownership row contains slave and no national faction.
definitions.hiddenMercenary: A mercenary_unit record carrying no_custom; retained for campaign, rebel, compatibility, or other non-custom use.
definitions.subfaction: A coherent named political, regional, or irregular pool with multiple related custom-visible records.
definitions.standardMercenary: A standalone mercenary, auxiliary, generic naval, or otherwise ungrouped custom-visible record.
